page-title.purpose: Primary page and match headings; catalogue phone headings reduce to 24px at 600px.

section-title.purpose: Grouped working content and analysis panels.

body.purpose: Production body density stays at 15px; density hooks do not change it.

metadata.purpose: Hints, timestamp captions and evidence basis.

figure.purpose: Comparable values use tabular numerals; contextual variants run 20–28px.

shadows.name: popover-light
shadows.purpose: Retained --shadow-pop token; production working cards remain flat.

shadows.name: autofill-surface
shadows.purpose: Pins an autofilled input to its field background; not structural elevation.

motion.name: recording-mode-transition
motion.purpose: Pointer-triggered supported transitions snapshot only the source instrument; root snapshots are disabled. A new action skips an in-flight snapshot without changing playback.

motion.name: reduced-motion-os
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce applies to descendants and pseudo-elements; match-source animations and explicit mode-control transitions are removed.

motion.name: reduced-motion-application
motion.purpose: The persisted Settings preference reduces descendant and pseudo-element animation/transition durations to 0.01ms. Both this flag and the OS preference bypass startViewTransition; only the OS CSS explicitly resets smooth scrolling.

narrative.overview:
Rally is a working interface for reviewing badminton recordings and their source-linked evidence. The confirmed light appearance uses a pale sage frame around a white working sheet, with a deep forest video instrument. Dark appearance uses the same hierarchy and geometry.

The system is compact, calm and legible. Archivo carries headings, controls and comparable figures; fine borders and tonal surfaces separate information without ornamental depth. The approved Rally logo family supplies the identity.
keyCharacteristics: Light sage frame, white working sheet and fixed dark video scope.
Archivo typography with compact labels and tabular figures.
Flat bordered groups, restrained green selection and explicit evidence states.
Responsive navigation and a video workspace that preserves its mounted media.

rules.name: The Field and Stage Rule
rules.body: Fields use field background, ink, placeholder and disabled roles. The video picture uses the fixed dark video well; the surrounding instrument resolves dark theme roles in either application appearance.

rules.name: The Evidence State Rule
rules.body: Semantic color accompanies words, line treatment or source context. Uncertain and unknown evidence remains visibly uncertain rather than borrowing the confirmed treatment.

rules.name: The Working Type Rule
rules.body: Body copy stays at 15px. Page and section titles establish hierarchy while labels, captions and tabular figures keep repeated information easy to compare.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Working sheets, cards and analysis groups are flat at rest. Borders and surface tones carry their structure.

dos: Do keep this contract scoped to apps/web and use the exact approved Rally logo assets.
Do resolve field and video colors through their own semantic roles in light and dark appearances.
Do use compact titles, tabular numerals and visible metric basis or uncertainty.
Do preserve one mounted video and its position when changing Standard, Focus or Collapsed mode.
Do retain keyboard focus feedback and honor both operating-system and application reduced-motion preferences.
Do allow layouts, controls and long recording titles to wrap at narrow widths.
donts: Don't apply this contract to the independent client website or historical prototype.
Don't use a dark video background token for ordinary input fields.
Don't replace evidence or missing values with invented scores, accuracy or progress.
Don't add decorative gradients, promotional panels or oversized metric tiles to the working interface.
Don't turn routine hover feedback into lifted cards or decorative looping motion.
